Kwame Mensah | Senior Product Manager, Lumina Interactive  
7 years shaping digital experiences in gaming  

As a Senior Product Manager at Lumina Interactive, I blend strategic vision with execution excellence to deliver game experiences that resonate. Over the past seven years, I’ve led cross-functional teams to launch titles across multiple platforms, driving user engagement through data-informed decisions and deep stakeholder collaboration.  

My career has been defined by building scalable product frameworks that align with business goals while staying agile in a fast-paced industry. I’ve spearheaded competitive analysis initiatives that positioned Lumina’s offerings as market leaders, and designed roadmaps that balance short-term wins with long-term innovation.  

A key focus has been bridging the gap between technical feasibility and creative ambition. Whether refining UX research to inform feature prioritization or optimizing SQL analytics pipelines to uncover player behavior patterns, I thrive at the intersection of data and design.  

Beyond execution, I mentor junior product managers, sharing insights on balancing ownership with collaboration. The gaming industry is ever-evolving, and I’m constantly exploring ways to integrate emerging technologies while staying rooted in player-centric outcomes.  

Let’s connect if you’re building the future of interactive entertainment—one click at a time.
